en.-1 keeps every link. Leaf–spine link IDs: -1 keeps every link. Leaf–spine link IDs start at 0 and range up to leaf × spine − 1.
en.0 leaves headroom unlimited. Exhausting: 0 leaves headroom unlimited. Exhausting a finite budget drops packets and uses LLR recovery.
en.0 leaves the number of in-flight chunks: 0 leaves the number of in-flight chunks unlimited. A smaller window limits incast bursts.
en.0 disables the rate cap. The sender pace: 0 disables the rate cap. The sender pacer enforces a nonzero cap.
en.0 uses 10000 ns. Set the target above th: 0 uses 10000 ns. Set the target above the RTT without queueing.
en.0 disables tail drop. RoCE enables it on: 0 disables tail drop. RoCE enables it only when explicitly set. Keep it below the VOQ capacity.
en.0 uses the credit count. A nonzero buffe: 0 uses the credit count. A nonzero buffer sets credits to buffer bytes / spray chunk bytes.

en.4294967295 allows unlimited retries. The: 4294967295 allows unlimited retries. The job timeout still applies.
en.BER is the error probability per bit. Pa: BER is the error probability per bit. Packet loss is the loss probability per packet. FEC corrects bit errors; packet loss requires retransmission.
en.Credits limit chunks sent per VC. The So: Credits limit chunks sent per VC. The So TX window limits chunks in flight between nodes. PFC and congestion control can run together.
en.FEC and link retries can run together. T: FEC and link retries can run together. The simulator forces LLR on for Ethernet, explicitly lossy RoCE, and finite PFC headroom.

zh.0 leaves the number of in-flight chunks: 0 不限在途分片；小窗口有助于控制 incast 突发。

zh.0 disables tail drop. RoCE enables it on: 0 关闭；RoCE 只有显式设置才开启尾丢包。须小于 VOQ 容量。

aliases.-1 不移除；Leaf–spine 编号从 0 开始，范围为 leaf × sp: -1 keeps every link. Leaf–spine link IDs start at 0 and range up to leaf × spine − 1.
aliases.0 不限制；耗尽后会丢包并使用 LLR 恢复。: 0 leaves headroom unlimited. Exhausting a finite budget drops packets and uses LLR recovery.
aliases.0 不限在途分片；小窗口有助于控制 incast 突发。: 0 leaves the number of in-flight chunks unlimited. A smaller window limits incast bursts.
aliases.0 不限速；通过发送端 pacer 实现。: 0 disables the rate cap. The sender pacer enforces a nonzero cap.
aliases.0 使用 10000 ns；目标应高于无排队时 RTT。: 0 uses 10000 ns. Set the target above the RTT without queueing.
aliases.0 关闭；RoCE 只有显式设置才开启尾丢包。须小于 VOQ 容量。: 0 disables tail drop. RoCE enables it only when explicitly set. Keep it below the VOQ capacity.
aliases.0 沿用信用额度；大于 0 时额度为缓冲区 / spray 分片大小。: 0 uses the credit count. A nonzero buffer sets credits to buffer bytes / spray chunk bytes.
aliases.4 KiB 请求送达后返回 64 KiB 响应: A delivered 4 KiB request triggers a 64 KiB response
aliases.4294967295 表示不设重试次数上限；任务仍受运行时间限制。: 4294967295 allows unlimited retries. The job timeout still applies.
aliases.BER 是每比特错误概率，丢包率是每包丢失概率。FEC 可以纠正误码，不能恢复随: BER is the error probability per bit. Packet loss is the loss probability per packet. FEC corrects bit errors; packet loss requires retransmission.
aliases.Credit 控制每个 VC 的可发分片数；So 窗口控制跨节点在途分片数。PF: Credits limit chunks sent per VC. The So TX window limits chunks in flight between nodes. PFC and congestion control can run together.
aliases.FEC 和链路重传可同时使用。Ethernet、显式开启尾丢包的 RoCE 和有: FEC and link retries can run together. The simulator forces LLR on for Ethernet, explicitly lossy RoCE, and finite PFC headroom.
aliases.GPU 数由 2 的维数次方决定。: The GPU count is 2 raised to the dimension count.
aliases.GPU 数由 X × Y × Z 决定。: The GPU count is X × Y × Z.
aliases.GPU 数由机架行数 × 列数决定。: The GPU count is rack rows × columns.
aliases.GPU 数由行数 × 列数决定。: The GPU count is rows × columns.
aliases.GPU 数须为 leaf 数的整数倍。: The GPU count must be divisible by the leaf count.
aliases.GPU 数须为 rail 数的整数倍；每 GPU 物理链路数须为 1。: The GPU count must be divisible by the rail count. Set physical links per GPU to 1.
aliases.两个发送端向同一目标发送: Two senders transmit to one destination
aliases.例如 0.001 表示 0.1%；控制包也可能丢失。: For example, 0.001 means 0.1%. Control packets can also be lost.
aliases.单节点 Leaf–spine 可将交换机间链路设为光链路，并在运行开始前移除一条: Use the single-node Leaf–spine builder to create optical inter-switch links and remove one before the run. This builder can model several switch tiers.
aliases.只接受顺序到达的数据，乱序数据触发缺口 NAK。: Accept data in order. Out-of-order arrivals trigger a gap NAK.
aliases.填写后覆盖配置中的分层 BER；下方显式填写的分层值仍优先。支持 1e-6。: Overrides inherited tier BERs. Explicit tier values below still take precedence. Scientific notation such as 1e-6 is supported.
aliases.大于 0 时覆盖包数设置。: A nonzero byte limit overrides the packet count.
aliases.支持跨节点 Ethernet 和 RoCE，不依赖 ECN。: Works across Ethernet and RoCE nodes without ECN.
aliases.每 GPU 物理链路数须不少于交换平面数。: Physical links per GPU must be at least the switch-plane count.
aliases.用于 RoCE 交换网络；需要队列达到 ECN 阈值后才能观察到降速。: For switched RoCE. Rate reduction starts after the queue reaches the ECN threshold.
aliases.移除链路时会自动重算路由。是否仍连通以原生结果为准。: Removing a link recomputes routes. Check the native results for remaining connectivity.
aliases.节点内 NVLink，节点间 Ethernet: NVLink within nodes, Ethernet between nodes
aliases.这些值会覆盖 profile 中的同名参数。物理链路数会影响交换拓扑的实际连线和: These values override the profile. Physical link count changes the wiring and bandwidth of switched topologies.
aliases.随机丢包下建议启用，避免 NACK 丢失后等待不结束。: Use this under random loss so a lost NACK does not leave the transfer waiting indefinitely.
aliases.须小于启用的丢包阈值。: Keep this below the active drop threshold.
aliases.须满足 N > K，且 2T ≤ N − K。: Requires N > K and 2T ≤ N − K.

aliases.链路字段写入本次实验的 [stack] 覆盖。也可以导入或编辑完整 .cfg 和: Link fields become [stack] overrides for this run. Import or edit .cfg and .profile text for custom experiments. Each run uses its own input snapshot.
aliases.Collective 通常为每 rank 数据量；stencil 由 trans: For collectives this is usually bytes per rank; stencil transfers use transfer.*.
aliases.ProtoBridge 互联通信仿真实验室：选择配置、运行 ns-3、查看交付时: ProtoBridge interconnect simulation: configure a scenario, run ns-3, and inspect delivery times and run history.
aliases.[op] 需要 collective / algorithm，或 transfe: [op] needs collective / algorithm or transfer.* definitions.
aliases.[stack] interNodeTopology 会覆盖同名 CLI 选择；请: [stack] interNodeTopology overrides the CLI value. Check the effective preview and native results.
aliases.collective 委托路径保留 inline VC 设置；这些 [stack: Collectives use the inline VC settings. These [stack] VC keys apply to transfer stencils.
aliases.interNodeFabricType 需要 ETH、RoCE 或 NVLink: interNodeFabricType must be ETH, RoCE, or NVLink.
aliases.interNodeTopology 不是支持的节点间拓扑。: interNodeTopology is not a supported inter-node topology.
aliases.profile 引用请在配置源码中修改。: Edit the profile reference in the configuration source.
aliases.profile 必须来自仓库的 configs/protocol_profile: The profile must come from configs/protocol_profiles/ in this repository.
aliases.{value0} 必须小于总 rank 数 {value1}。: {value0} must be less than the rank count, {value1}.
aliases.{value0} 需要 0–1000000000 的整数。: {value0} must be an integer from 0 to 1000000000.
aliases.不支持 CLI 参数 {value0}；硬件和协议参数请在配置中编辑。: Unsupported CLI flag {value0}. Edit hardware and protocol parameters in the configuration.
aliases.传输 stencil 请保留 transfer.*；修改 collective: Keep transfer.* definitions for a transfer stencil. Choose a collective template to change the collective algorithm.
aliases.单次实验最多支持 80 项覆盖参数。: A run supports at most 80 overrides in each parameter group.
aliases.多节点场景的总 rank 数需在 2–256 之间。: Multi-node scenarios need 2–256 ranks in total.
aliases.操作覆盖只支持 collective、algorithm 和 topology。: Operation overrides support only collective, algorithm, and topology.
aliases.第 {value0} 行的键或值无效。: Invalid key or value on line {value0}.
aliases.覆盖值只能是一个数值或参数标识符。: Each override must be a single number or parameter identifier.
aliases.请求和响应大小由 transfer.*.bytes 决定；默认分别为 4 KiB: transfer.*.bytes determines request and response sizes. The defaults are 4 KiB and 64 KiB.
aliases.请选择仓库 profile，或在编辑器内提供完整 profile 内容。: Choose a repository profile or provide the complete profile text in the editor.
aliases.配置第 {value0} 行：只支持 [stack] 和 [op]。: Configuration line {value0}: only [stack] and [op] sections are supported.
aliases.配置需要 [stack] profile 和非空 [op]。: The configuration needs a [stack] profile and a nonempty [op] section.
aliases.随机跨节点流量需要至少两个节点。: Random inter-node traffic requires at least two nodes.
aliases.DCQCN 需要 RoCE 和含交换机的节点间拓扑；Ethernet 可选择 R: DCQCN needs RoCE and a switched inter-node topology. Use RTTCC with Ethernet.
aliases.FEC 参数需要 N > K，且 2T ≤ N − K。即使关闭 FEC，参数也: FEC requires N > K and 2T ≤ N − K. The native model requires a valid tuple even when FEC is off.
aliases.Hierarchical 需要多节点场景，或 Leaf–spine / NVL7: Hierarchical algorithms need multiple nodes or a grouped Leaf–spine / NVL72 topology.
aliases.Leaf 数需要能被中间层交换机数整除。: The leaf count must be divisible by the middle-tier switch count.
aliases.Multi-plane 要求 linksPerGpu 不小于平面数。: Multi-plane requires linksPerGpu to be at least the plane count.
aliases.NVL72 要求 GPU 数能被每组 GPU 数整除。: NVL72 requires the GPU count to be divisible by GPUs per group.
aliases.PFC 暂停阈值须小于已启用的 VOQ 丢包阈值。: The PFC pause threshold must be below the active VOQ drop threshold.
aliases.PFC 模式 3 需要大于 0 的暂停时间（µs）。: PFC mode 3 needs a positive pause time in µs.
aliases.Rail fat-tree 要求 GPU 数能被 rail 数整除，并设置 li: Rail fat-tree requires the GPU count to be divisible by the rail count and linksPerGpu = 1.
aliases.So 发送窗口和拥塞控制仅作用于跨节点流量，单节点场景中不会生效。: The So TX window and congestion control apply only to inter-node traffic.
aliases.VOQ 丢包阈值须小于交换机 VOQ 容量；0 表示关闭丢包。: The VOQ drop threshold must be below the switch VOQ capacity. 0 disables tail drop.
aliases.[stack] / profile 中的 {value0} 不会传给原生 CLI: {value0} in [stack] / profile is not forwarded to the native CLI. Set it in the form or extra CLI flags.
aliases.flowControl 当前仅实现 credit；window/rate 是预留: flowControl currently implements only credit. window/rate are reserved interfaces. Use soTxWindow for a TX window and DCQCN / RTTCC for rate control.
aliases.topology 不是支持的物理拓扑。: topology is not a supported physical topology.
aliases.{value0} 不支持算法 {value1}；请选择该操作提供的算法。: {value0} does not support {value1}. Choose an algorithm supported by this operation.
aliases.{value0} 使用配置 / profile 的值 {value1}，覆盖附加: {value0} uses the configuration / profile value {value1}, overriding the extra CLI value {value2}.
aliases.{value0} 要求 GPU 数 {value1} 能被 leaf / 路由器: {value0} requires the GPU count {value1} to be divisible by the leaf / router count {value2}.
aliases.传输 stencil 的 {value0} 使用 profile / [stac: The stencil uses the profile / [stack] value {value1} for {value0}, overriding the extra CLI value {value2}.
aliases.光链路编号需在 0–{value0} 之间。: The optical link ID must be between 0 and {value0}.
aliases.已注入错误而未启用 LLR；未被 FEC 纠正的丢失可能使操作无法完成。: Errors are enabled without LLR. Losses that FEC cannot correct may prevent completion.
aliases.开启 DCQCN 和尾丢包时，ECN 标记阈值须小于丢包阈值。: With DCQCN and tail drop enabled, keep the ECN marking threshold below the drop threshold.
aliases.当前光链路故障选项用于单节点统一拓扑构建器；请选择单节点 Leaf–spine。: Optical link failure uses the single-node topology builder. Choose single-node Leaf–spine.
aliases.当前节点间拓扑没有交换机，PFC 不会触发；可选 Host / ToR / Ra: This inter-node topology has no switches, so PFC cannot trigger. Choose Host / ToR / Rail / Leaf–spine.
aliases.当前集合通信没有完整的 FEC 码字参数，FEC 未启用；可在纠错与重传中填写: This collective has no complete FEC tuple, so FEC is off. Set N, K, and T under Error correction and retries.
aliases.拓扑维度决定实际 GPU 数为 {value0}。: The topology dimensions set the actual GPU count to {value0}.
aliases.拓扑维度生成 {value0} 个 GPU；网页支持 2–256 个。: The topology dimensions produce {value0} GPUs. The WebUI supports 2–256.
aliases.突发误码实验请关闭 FEC；当前 FEC 接收路径按独立 BER 解码，不经过突: Turn FEC off for burst-error experiments. The native FEC receive path uses independent-BER decoding rather than the burst model.
aliases.突发误码模式需要大于 0 的统一 BER，以启用原生突发错误检测。: Burst mode needs a positive uniform BER to enable native burst-error detection.
aliases.网页的单光链路故障实验需要 Leaf–spine 拓扑，并将交换机间介质设为光链: A single-link failure experiment needs Leaf–spine with optical inter-switch links.
aliases.该 Fabric / 丢包设置会由原生仿真器强制开启 LLR。: The native simulator forces LLR on for this fabric / drop configuration.
aliases.跨节点流控实验建议选择 Ethernet 或 RoCE，并在原生结果中核对控制事: Use Ethernet or RoCE for inter-node flow-control experiments and check control-event counters in the native results.
aliases.随机错误可能使 NACK 丢失；可启用“超时主动重传”来恢复这类传输。: Random errors can drop NACKs. Enable Retransmit on timeout to recover those transfers.
aliases.非分层 AllToAll 使用同一 AlltoAllInjector；CollN: Non-hierarchical AllToAll choices share AlltoAllInjector. The CollNet names are aliases for that path.
aliases.仿真程序不存在，请重新构建。: Simulator binary not found. Rebuild gpu-cluster-sim.
aliases.仿真程序退出，退出码 {value0}。请查看运行日志。: The simulator exited with code {value0}. Check the run log.
aliases.传输尚未全部交付，不能将该时长作为已完成操作的延迟。: Delivery is incomplete. This time cannot be used as the latency of a completed operation.
aliases.服务停止，任务尚未运行。: The service stopped before this job ran.
aliases.服务停止，运行已中断。: The service stopped and interrupted this run.
aliases.服务在上次运行结束前停止，请重新提交。: The service stopped before the previous run finished. Submit it again.
aliases.程序需要输出且仅输出一个完整 RESULT 结果块。: The simulator must emit exactly one complete RESULT block.
aliases.结果缺少有效的 status。: The result has no valid status.
aliases.结果缺少有效的整数 simTimeNs。: The result has no valid integer simTimeNs.
aliases.结果重复包含 {value0}。: The result contains {value0} more than once.
aliases.请先在仓库根目录执行 ./ns3 build gpu-cluster-sim。: Run ./ns3 build gpu-cluster-sim from the repository root first.
aliases.运行日志超过 16 MiB，已停止任务。: The run log exceeded 16 MiB. The job was stopped.
aliases.运行超过 {value0} 秒，已停止。: The run exceeded {value0} seconds and was stopped.
aliases.队列已有 16 个未完成任务，请等待或取消任务后再提交。: The queue already has 16 unfinished jobs. Wait or cancel a job before submitting another.
aliases.请从当前网页提交任务。: Submit jobs from the current WebUI origin.
aliases.运行结束后可下载完整记录。: The complete archive is available after the run finishes.
aliases.这次运行没有生成这个文件。: This run did not produce that artifact.
aliases.服务器响应无法读取，请检查服务是否仍在运行。: Cannot read the server response. Check that the service is running.
aliases.附加 CLI 参数需为 JSON 对象。: Extra CLI flags must be a JSON object.
aliases.实际传输量由配置中的 transfer.*.bytes 表达式决定。: The transfer.*.bytes expressions determine the actual transfer sizes.
aliases.附加 CLI 参数的 JSON 格式无效。: Invalid JSON in Extra CLI flags.
aliases.已进入队列，等待前一任务结束。: Queued. Waiting for the preceding run to finish.
aliases.等待仿真完成: Waiting for the simulation to finish
aliases.完成时记录程序运行时间: Wall time is recorded when the run finishes
aliases.[页面仅显示日志末尾，可下载完整日志]\n: [Showing the end of the log. Download the complete log for all output.]
aliases.此场景未记录步骤数据。可在原始日志中查看运行结果。: This scenario has no step trace. See the raw log for its results.
aliases.等待 injector 写入步骤数据…: Waiting for the injector to write step records…
aliases.尚未找到仿真程序。请先在仓库根目录运行：./ns3 build gpu-clus: Simulator binary not found. Run ./ns3 build gpu-cluster-sim from the repository root.
aliases.已载入配置，可修改后重新运行: Inputs loaded. Edit them and run again.
aliases.一次最多对比 6 个实验: Compare at most 6 runs at a time.
aliases.浏览器未允许复制，请从完整运行记录中下载 config.cfg: Clipboard access was denied. Download config.cfg from the run archive.
aliases.选择实际物理连接方式；算法与拓扑分别设置。: Choose the physical links between devices. Select the collective algorithm separately.
aliases.按节点分组，分别执行节点内与节点间通信。: Groups ranks by node and runs intra-node and inter-node phases.
aliases.NVLS / SHARP 需要单节点 NVSwitch；分层算法需要多节点或分组: NVLS / SHARP need single-node NVSwitch. Hierarchical algorithms need multiple nodes or grouped topologies.
aliases.设置节点间网络的尺寸，例如 spine 数量或 torus 宽度。0 表示自动选: Set the inter-node network size, such as spine count or torus width. 0 selects it automatically. The defaults usually suffice.
aliases.Leaf 连接 GPU，Spine 连接各个 Leaf。这里设置两层交换机的数量: Leaf switches connect GPUs; spine switches connect the leaves. Set the switch count in each tier. GPU count must be divisible by leaf count. Valid defaults are provided.
aliases.设置网格的行数和列数。例如 2 行 × 4 列对应 8 个 GPU；修改维度后: Set mesh rows and columns. For example, 2 rows × 4 columns gives 8 GPUs. Changing the dimensions updates the GPU count.
aliases.设置环绕网络的 X、Y、Z 维长度。例如 2 × 2 × 2 对应 8 个 GP: Set torus dimensions X, Y, and Z. For example, 2 × 2 × 2 gives 8 GPUs. Changing the dimensions updates the GPU count.
aliases.设置超立方体维数 d，GPU 总数为 2 的 d 次方。例如 3 维对应 8 个: Set hypercube dimension d. The GPU count is 2 to the power d; 3 dimensions gives 8 GPUs.
aliases.设置当前物理网络的交换机数量或维度。已有默认值，可以直接运行；修改前请查看参数旁: Set switch counts or dimensions for this network. The defaults are ready to run. Check the constraints beside each field before changing them.
aliases.Root rank 从 0 开始编号：Broadcast 从这个 GPU 发出数: Root ranks start at 0. Broadcast sends data from this GPU; Reduce delivers the result to this GPU.
aliases.通道数控制并行 ring 的数量。0 表示按每节点 GPU 数自动设置。: Channels set the number of parallel rings. 0 selects the count from GPUs per node.
aliases.Hierarchical 分别执行节点内和节点间通信。这里选择节点内阶段使用 R: Hierarchical operations have intra-node and inter-node phases. Choose Ring or Full mesh for the intra-node phase here. The topology selectors above set the physical links.
aliases.选项加载失败，请刷新页面: Unable to load choices. Reload the page.
aliases.前一传输交付后: After the preceding transfer is delivered
aliases.此拓扑暂无结构图，连接参数见配置快照。: No structural diagram is available for this topology. See the input snapshot for link settings.
aliases.为便于阅读，最多显示 16 个 rank；完整数据见下载包中的 steps.cs: The chart shows at most 16 ranks. Download steps.csv for the complete trace.
